en-US: Keep newly created notes selected after sync, and make links between publicly shared notes open correctly.
Make downloaded desktop updates clearly actionable so they can be installed without hunting for the update control.
Prevent desktop edits from being reported as sync conflicts after a newer local change supersedes an in-flight sync.
Improve nested-list editing so Tab, Shift+Tab, Backspace, and indentation controls behave consistently.
zh-CN: 修复新建笔记同步后的选中状态，并让公开分享笔记之间的引用链接正确打开。
让已下载的桌面更新显示明确的安装入口，无需再寻找更新控件。
修复桌面端较新的本地编辑覆盖同步中变更时被误报为同步冲突的问题。
改进多级列表编辑，使 Tab、Shift+Tab、退格键和缩进控件的行为保持一致。
